A '''wooden spear''' is the [[Wooden equipment|wooden]] [[spear]], crafted from {{MCW|Planks|planks}}. It deals 1 damage at an attack speed of 1.538 and has 59 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/wooden_spear.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which sets the stats shown in the infobox.

== Usage ==

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Planks|planks}}. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).
